description:
DESTRUCTIVE - permanently delete a VPS created by cloud_provision and release its
    public IP. Terminating removes the server (and its volumes + public IP) at the user's
    provider. Use it to
    tear down a half-built box (cloud_provision returns a destroy_hint on failure) or one
    you no longer want. Credentials by PATH: api_key_file=<path>, never inline; never echoed.
    dry_run shows the exact call; confirm
    executes. Guarded destructive → needs confirm=true.
name: cloud_destroy
